items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: I had played with them during Papa Celestan time.

ctx.x: Okay, let's see, this is reel two of Wilbert Tillman, January 20th, 1966. We were talking about the Tulane Van, and you say you can't remember too many more other than those we just named, huh? No, I can't remember them. That's too far back. Oh, yeah. Well, did you ever play with the original Toxia? The original Toxia? Yeah, when...
I never was a member, but I had played with them during Papa Celestan time. Yeah, I played with them, but I never was a member of them.
I see. Do you remember who was in that band, any of the people on that you heard?
